scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — Light Grenade Super variant

records.name: Light Grenade (Super)
records.effect: Charges the attack by repeated input and fires a powerful Ki projectile; the Super variant is distinct from Light Grenade (Ultimate).

notes: Dedicated skill documentation explicitly identifies this as a Ki Blast Super, 100 Ki, obtained through training with Piccolo, and used by Piccolo, Gohan (Adult), and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed). Because the source gives a training unlock and the skill is not categorized as unavailable for CaC, usable_by_cac is recorded true.
